old.sw18: Why does the brain build this armor? Psychologist Lindsay Gibson explains that [*Adult children of emotionally immature parents*](https://www.amazon.com/Adult-Children-Emotionally-Immature-Parents/dp/B01F2L1HLM/ref=sr_1_1?crid=2JLWO51H6BXO1&dib=eyJ2IjoiMSJ9.WNWQbN2kbLNCbYq_W-fodAEeQ_UlnBi9Ju6cPln8M1TPg-RV-3-nRjn0Qj-b2kgxvix3vglikzPoFdr6m1bV4ZrTYX1qWRDNS0Dbk17dV3oK-KP3CXCX7QstfIkQGtiiLMJyKwT9N66J8RW_F6c7YoH8oGEsjPnyij0gNk5i-nnTMPGQa4VFhVtocMt46Fax3GwdCYOwIduJYQPc1LjZSgr9sS7b1bTey37wCvpdEnc.YYpzi2NWlm3O9D3YaGlV-1PGakmscQwxvmqh3imaiA8&dib_tag=se&keywords=children+of+emotionally+immature+parents&qid=1766678988&s=books&sprefix=children+of+emotionally+immature+parents%2Cstripbooks%2C395&sr=1-1) survive by creating a "Role-Self"--a defensive personality designed to please others and manage the parent's emotions. But we can't just blame our immature parents for this Role Self. It really is true what they say: "It takes a village to raise a child." The modern large society with only one or two people caring for the children is vastly insufficient. As Dr. Bruce Perry explains, our brains evolved in hunter-gatherer bands with a ratio of 4 developmentally mature adults to 1 child. Today, our "enriched" environments offer 1 immature adult to 4 children.
old.p030: Before applying the tools, you must understand what actually goes wrong in the brain during trauma, withdrawal or chronic stress, the "Hardware Failures" the tools are for.
old.p032: If you've tried to talk yourself out of a trigger and couldn't, that's because anatomy overrides intellect. Dr. Perry describes a "Metabolic Red Line" for the traumatized brain: once your resting heart rate goes up or your heart-rate variability drops (a state of "Fear"), blood flow shifts away from the Cortex, which does logic and reasoning, and down to the Brainstem, which runs survival.
old.p033: So if you try to process trauma while you're above this red line, you're adding to the armor instead of taking it off. That's why many trauma therapies emphasize staying within a manageable "window of tolerance" rather than overwhelming activation. In that state your functional IQ drops a lot, and the Nucleus Accumbens gets flooded with the catecholamines that transcribe new DeltaFosB proteins, the "armor" itself (DeltaFosB may be the master switch, but the research isn't settled).
